plan_authority: Volodymyr Demkiv — original approval plus 2026-08-26 amendment and night-flow decision authority in Codex task 01a03619-63a9-7743-90f9-1b6b1945b6ac: Design revision 2 (evidence a12cfc95600cb0d8e90bd4ec5eb7b52f19b5d8a453e3c4e4af0be9b94fc7186c; content 96021883df4c2af7396e092ac69fb3400399bc4c0ce80e2361b70e0effa4bef7) retires Taskplane scheduler/capacity/reservation/DAG authority and binds deterministic Taskplane intents to Codex native dispatch observation

criteria: Normal loop next output is delta-shaped and under 4000 tokens, and any wave hitting 8 hours, 60 observed native sessions, 150M total tokens, or 25M uncached input stops for human scope review.

The Plan classifies every task pair as parallel or serialized for a named shared owner; Taskplane emits stable intents for every ready pairwise-disjoint task, Codex dispatches them concurrently, one event-driven wait covers the outstanding set, and Retro reports parallelism factor plus longest serial chain from native trace evidence.
AC2 measures a fresh checkout at the same SHA reaching the first executing pickup checkpoint in under two minutes before R-0013 resumes.
The Plan gate declares delivery mode, stamps it into receipts, and the engine prevents build-mode dispatch from instantiating automatic lens workers.
expected_lenses=[] plus a schema-valid result succeeds with an explicit empty-collection receipt and never requires outage resolution.
An unstarted review kernel can be rebound only by attributed human authority with an append-only override receipt; any started slot remains immutable.
The live Codex host produces conformant observable producer receipts for evaluator and EM submissions without manual outage resolution.
Every acceptance criterion names exact test files and selectors in the Design Contract, and the checkpoint refuses by name when any declared test file is absent.
Every changed producer has a closed map to generated artifacts, documentation, release surfaces, manifests, CI, runtime, and host consumers, and every edge names a severed-edge or freshness test.

Feature-green and release-green are distinct receipts; tag, install, or publication requires closed wiring evidence, the full matrix, and successful pushed-SHA proof, while any override records released-unverified and every skipped proof.
Hosted repository preparation resolves and tests the fetched remote default branch before dereferencing bare HEAD, including a non-master default-branch severed-edge case.
